rules.title: Prohibition of source-of-income discrimination
rules.quote: In the City of Boston, it's illegal to discriminate when renting, buying, selling, or securing financing for any housing. You can't discriminate someone based on their: Race Color Religion Disability National Origin Ancestry Sex Gender Identity Gender Expression Age Sexual Orientation Marital Status Rental Assistance * Family Status ** Military Status
rules.summary: It is illegal to discriminate against tenants based on rental assistance (such as Section 8 vouchers) when renting housing in Boston.
